sentences.text:
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 8700 of 2024
Applicant :- Indal

Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko
Counsel for Applicant :- Ashish Raman Mishra
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Supplementary affidavit filed today in Court is taken on record.

2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.
3.
The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.169 of 2024, under Section 376(2)(Tha) of IPC, P.S. Ramgaon, District Bahraich.
4. In terms of the FIR, allegations were levelled for commission of the offence under Section 376 IPC in respect of the victim aged about 19 years.

Subsequently, it is argued by counsel for the applicant Indal vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko on 13 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/145601381/

entities.text: Indal vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: that the informant did not support the prosecution story in view of the statement recorded during trial.
He argues that the applicant and the victim are intending to get married with the consent of the police.
The applicant is also ready and willing to marry the victim.
5. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.

6. Considering the statement of the informant recorded during trial and the arguments as raised by counsel for the applicant, the applicant who is in custody since 27.04.2024 and has no criminal history, is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.

7. Let the applicant Indal be released on bail in aforesaid FIR number on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
8.
In case the applicant resiles from his promise to marry, the victim would be at liberty to file a bail cancellation application.

Order Date :- 13.8.2024 nishant  Indal vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko on 13 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/145601381/
